expectations.detail: event:guard_trip not observed within 3s after fault_fired (seq 0) [BLOCKED: firmware/SaftyFW/src/tasks/safety_core.c's safety_core_build_input() never sets main_fault_asserted -- discrete_task.c's discrete_task_main_fault() (a real, 200ms-debounced GPIO10 read) exists and is called nowhere in safety_core.c (grepped this pass; only discrete_task_estop_pressed() is called there for S7). safety_guards.c's S6a block only checks `if (in->main_fault_asserted)`, which is therefore always false, so S6a cannot trip against present-day SaftyFW regardless of what KilnFW's own GPIO10 line does -- this is true even though the fixture's half of the story (getting KilnFW to genuinely assert mainFault) works exactly as this scenario's own header comment describes.]
